composition.story: Gradient descent minimizes loss by shifting parameters against the slope. Each step reduces the error until convergence at the minimum.

aha.observation: At the minimum, the gradient approaches zero and updates cease.

states.label: Start
states.sentence: Initialize parameter at an arbitrary high point.
states.why: Starting point on the loss curve.

states.label: First Descent
states.sentence: Compute gradient and take a step downhill.
states.why: Steep slope yields a large parameter update.

states.label: Convergence
states.sentence: Gradient is zero; loss is at its global minimum.
